answer: Proof of Burn functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for AI agents by requiring the irreversible destruction of native tokens. Like a falcon tracking prey, the protocol detects identity clusters; if an entity attempts to flood the network via a willow of synthetic nodes, the system forces a resource expenditure proportional to each fake identity. This creates a cost-intensive barrier, acting as a prism that refracts malicious influence and ensures that only agents with skin in the game persist.
